content.text: The config service's own `SELECT Config` spans are the failing part. Its CPU and memory look normal. Before deciding between a database-call fault and a network fault on config→mysql, I'll check the network metrics on that connection.

input.query: SELECT 'abn' src, metric, attr_source, attr_destination, count(*) n, round(avg(value),2) avgv, round(max(value),2) maxv FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric LIKE 'hubble%' AND (attr_source LIKE '%config%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%config%' OR attr_source LIKE '%mysql%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%mysql%') GROUP BY 2,3,4 UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', metric, attr_source, attr_destination, count(*), round(avg(value),2), round(max(value),2) FROM normal_metrics_sum WHERE metric LIKE 'hubble%' AND (attr_source LIKE '%config%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%config%' OR attr_source LIKE '%mysql%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%mysql%') GROUP BY 2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,3,4,1

content.text: No drops or retransmits on config↔mysql, so the network is not the fault; the failure is inside config's own DB calls. Next I'll trace where errors first appear in the chain above config, and check the payment and class-loading signals.

input.query: SELECT service_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) n, sum(case when attr_status_code='Error' then 1 else 0 end) errs, round(min(duration)/1e6,1) min_ms, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) avg_ms, round(max(duration)/1e6,1) max_ms, min(time) first_t, max(time) last_t FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-seat-service','ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-route-plan-service','ts-travel-plan-service','ts-ui-dashboard','ts-payment-service','ts-inside-payment-service') AND (attr_status_code='Error' OR duration>1e9) GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

content.text: The failure chain is visible: config's DB calls fail, then seat's calls to config time out at ~60 s, then route-plan, travel and travel2 time out. Next I'll confirm travel's errors and check the payment path, which has an onset at 66 s.

input.query: SELECT 'abn' src, service_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) n, sum(case when attr_status_code='Error' then 1 else 0 end) errs, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) avg_ms, round(max(duration)/1e6,1) max_ms FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-payment-service','ts-inside-payment-service','ts-ui-dashboard') AND attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', service_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), sum(case when attr_status_code='Error' then 1 else 0 end), round(avg(duration)/1e6,1), round(max(duration)/1e6,1) FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-payment-service','ts-inside-payment-service','ts-ui-dashboard') AND attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 3,2,1
